The world's largest technology exhibition, CES 2023, will be held in Las Vegas, U.S., from Thursday, January 5 to Sunday, January 8 in local time.
Aving News hosted the BEST OF MIK (Made in Korea) @ CES 2023 Award with global corporation and YouTubers for Korean start-ups.

The screening was conducted by U.S. Tech blog Ubergizmo, U.S. YouTuber Geekazine, French IT/Tech media Lecaf Du Geek, global news network Aving News, and Japanese tech media Gadgetouch, based on the start-ups’ market potential and technological innovation.
The winners of the BEST OF MIK @ CES 2023 awards include Margo (selected by Geekazine), BEOMJUN E&C (Aving News), LiBEST (Gadgetouch), Nuvilab (Lecaf Du Geek), and Narma Inc. (Ubergizmo).

Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES is a stage where global companies gather in one place to display their cutting-edge technologies and new products — the engine of future industry and growth. Along with the exhibition, more than 500 events such as keynote speeches, conferences, and sessions will take place with over 450 speakers from businesses, governments, and organizations.

CES 2022 which was held earlier last year was not attended by major global companies due to the severe COVID-19 outbreak. However, this year’s CES is expected to become the largest offline event in the U.S., attracting nearly 100,000 visitors. CES 2023 will be attended by more than 2,800 firms from 173 countries, marking an increase of more than 40% in size than last year’s event.
Mago Presents GyroSpeed to Help Efficient Pitch Training in CES 2023

Sports tech start-up Mago has recently introduced a product called GyroSpeed to the market. GyroSpeed detects the starting and ending points of the user’s pitching action by using a gyro sensor to calculate the maximum acceleration per interval, along with another gyro sensor to measure acceleration This feature predicts the user’s pitching speed and displays the data on the OLED screen mounted on the product.

The technology that facilitates pitching training is the essence of this product. Users can intuitively check the changes in ball speed based on the velocity of the arm movement, and the immediate feedback enhances engagement and motivation for training. Also, it automatically saves the number of exercises so that users can view their training hours. If necessary, users may set a separate goal for goal-driven and systematic training.

According to Mago's CEO Tae hoon Kim, “We desperately need tools to assist consistent training while reducing the risk of injury in order to boost pitching ability. However, existing products in the market have not been improved in terms of performance for a long time, and they were dependent on the user's perseverance.” Kim added, “That is why we came up with a product that would expand the market and help newcomers maintain their interests in baseball. GyroSpeed is the one solution satisfies those needs.”

“From this CES, the largest of the various global exhibitions, we expect to find buyers who will be responsible for the distribution of GyroSpeed in the U.S. online sports marketplace,” Kim explained. “We also intend to increase synergies for crowdfunding in the United States through active promotion of our products.”
BEOMJUN E&C Announces New Technology Utilizing Waste Sulfur in CES 2023

BEOMJUN E&C is a business that develops new technologies to reform waste sulfur, an industrial product generated during the oil refining process, to use and process it as concrete and asphalt additives. The green growth leader is approved by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport for their technology.

At the exhibition, the company will introduce modification sulfur cement concrete additive (SU⁺ C100). This is a highly functional and eco-friendly cement concrete additive manufactured by using a modifier in DCPD discharged from a petrochemical plant and sulfur generated as crude oil, and gas purification by-products. Their product has been designated as a new and excellent national technology and awarded the Great King Sejong Prize. In addition, the asphalt concrete modifier (SU⁺ A100) is an eco-friendly asphalt binder with better elongation, utilizing sulfur by-products.

Furthermore, BEOMJUN E&C developed an eco-friendly process called PBI (Protect Black Ice) which uses 0% of calcium chloride. It is available for long-period use in a single construction project by adding materials that absorb and release the temperature of the road surface according to the atmospheric environment of the micro-sulfur biome product, thus boosting the strength of road pavement job. The environmentally-friendly process mixes calcium, magnesium, and acetate (CMA) with a porous material and a phase change material (PCM) instead of antifreeze substances such as salt and calcium chloride. Since it prevents freezing from -1 C to -4 C degrees, traffic accidents caused by black ice are prevented.

According to a representative from BEOMJUN E&C, “In this CES, we want to spread the competitiveness of our differentiated products along with the importance of an environmentally friendly construction industry through the use of high performance concrete and asphalt additives.” They added “We will continue to develop R&D by securing excellent talent in the future.”
LiBEST Presents its Fire Retardant Freeze-resistant Battery Manufacturing Technology in CES 2023
Flexible secondary battery manufacturing start-up LiBEST will showcase its fire retardant freeze-resistant battery manufacturing technology at CES 2023.

It is widely known that the cold sub-zero weather we're seeing these days can deteriorate battery performance. Temperature has a major impact on the runtime of smartphones as well as EVs. According to a LiBEST representative, “Lower temperatures can even disable these vehicles. When such cases happen, people may misinterpret it as a product failure, but for the most part, they are battery problems. Temperature drop results in frozen electrolyte, which in turn leads to lower conductivity of the lithium ion. For this reason, lithium ion batteries typically perform 40 - 70% of their original capacity in sub-zero temperatures.”

LiBEST’s fire retardant freeze-resistant battery manufacturing technology is somewhat different. For the anode and cathode, NMC and graphite are used as usual but their special electrolyte was combined with a separating membrane. That is why the battery maintains its voltage and high energy density while providing fire retardant and freeze-resistant features.

Direct exposure of a typical battery's electrolyte to a flame of about 1,300˚C causes the electrolyte to ignite quickly, and the flame persists until all of the electrolyte is burned away. Under the same condition, LiBEST’s electrolyte takes a longer time to ignite, comparable to incombustible materials. Even when ignited, the flame is soon extinguished, suppressing direct ignition at the battery cell level.

In the case of the battery which LiBEST is currently developing, it even operates at -40˚C, the temperature that disables normal electrolyte, and the battery is normally charged and discharged at –20˚C and –10˚C. Also, this battery with its high energy-density designed for battery electric vehicles (BEVs) retains over 90% capacity, even after 500 charges and discharges.
Nuvilab Presents Future Vision of Diets and Healthcare in CES 2023
Nuvilab that has taken part in the event since 2020 and will set up its first dedicated booth this year, introducing key solutions based on digital healthcare, food technology, and sustainability.

The start-up sees this CES where over 170,000 people are expected to visit from 158 countries as an opportunity to accelerate its global expansion. This will be the first time that Nuvilab showcases its key solution, “AI Food Scanner,” along with digital healthcare offerings such as an infant growth management solution, diet management solution for people with chronic conditions, mobile food diaries, and food scanning APIs.

Its booth in CES will also showcase the success cases of the Zero Waste campaign, which was jointly conducted by SK Telecom and Nuvilab to realize Net Zero. SK Telecom launched a six-month campaign for ESG action in the workplace by introducing Nuvilab’s solution in its employee cafeteria, reducing food waste and thereby lowering carbon emissions.

According to Nuvilab’s CEO, Daehoon Kim, “We are confident that our food technology will lead innovation not only in the ESG industry, but also in the healthcare industry.” They added, “This CES 2023 will be a great opportunity to promote our technology even further and collaborate with world-class enterprises.”
Narma Introduces Motorized Dual Tiltrotor Drone Optimized for Shipping in CES 2023

Narma, Korea Aerospace Research Institute's first research business, developed the world's first motorized dual tiltrotor drone optimized for shipping. The tiltrotor is capable of vertical take-off and landing as well as high-speed flight, with the ability to load a 5kg payload and fly 40 kilometers in 40 minutes. Among the drone makers in the country, Narma is the only one that has been simultaneously licensed by the government to fly two types of special flights (BVLOS and night flights). Last year, their drone took off in front of the National Assembly building and operated Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) flight across the clusters of buildings in Seoul for a demo flight hosted by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

Although shipping drones are also being developed by global makers, their weight, wind resistance, and shipping costs based on cargo cannot compete with Narma which prides itself on its tiltrotor drones as “by far the best in the world.” Unlike conventional drones piloted by experienced pilots, Narma's drones have the advantage of being able to fly automatically using simple maneuverable devices, such as kiosks, without manual intervention. To reduce manufacturing costs, Narma introduced new technologies to create carbon plates without manual molding, and the new method dramatically reduced manufacturing time and costs, allowing their products to compete with even automobiles and motorcycles.

The maximum speed of the “AF 100” with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) is 120 km/h. It has a wider operating area than multicopter drones, enabling users to control it in real time using a camera. In addition, drones placed in their station will always be ready to take off with their battery charged to 70%.

The business plans to cooperate with a Korean convenience store chain, CU, to start a full-scale drone delivery service in the country. This year, Narma offered drone shipping solutions using its product to several countries, including South Africa, Croatia, Ethiopia, and the Philippines. The company also signed SKD contracts with partners in South Africa and Croatia, realizing its first actual exports. Narma aims to expand its business to North America next year.

CES, the world's largest IT fair, is an exhibition that provides a comprehensive view of the global consumer electronics industry in one place. It is held annually in Las Vegas in January by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News has annually reported on CES news for the world for 17 consecutive years since 2006, hosting the Best of CES which selects the best innovative products and technologies, and the Best of Made in Korea that chooses the most innovative businesses in South Korea. In addition, the media has delivered breaking news about CES through AIVING LIVE.
